title: Envelope
description: One hand-off appended to a run's append-only mailbox. Envelopes are the only channel between root and the Orchestrator, and between the Orchestrator and a generated execution agent; a run's state is a pure reduction over the ordered sequence of these envelopes and is never mutated directly. See AI_Codex/Architecture/ADR/0014-generated-workflow-deterministic-kernel.md, decision 2. This is the authoritative Envelope contract; scripts/kernel_specs.py validates every constructed Envelope against this file rather than against a hand-duplicated field list. schema_version 2 (Outcome 3 Task 1) adds `previous_hash`, chaining each envelope to the one before it in its run's mailbox so the log is tamper-evident; see scripts/kernel_specs.py's GENESIS_HASH and Envelope.hash(), and scripts/oqc.py's verify().

schema_version.description: Envelope contract version. Never inferred; always checked explicitly.

envelope_id.description: Unique identifier for this envelope within its run's mailbox. Assignment and ordering are a mailbox concern, not this schema's.

run_id.description: Identifies the run this envelope belongs to. Matches RunSpec.run_id.

sender.description: Role identifier of the envelope's origin: 'root', 'orchestrator', or 'agent:<agent_id>'. Legal sender/recipient pairing (root<->orchestrator, orchestrator<->worker only) is enforced by the router introduced in a later task, not by this schema.

recipient.description: Role identifier of the envelope's destination. Same shape as sender.

kind.description: What the envelope carries: a bounded request to an agent, a completed result, a state/status notice, a question that needs a root answer, or that answer.

payload.description: Kind-specific content, e.g. a compiled brief and its hash for 'request', or a produced artifact and its hash for 'result'. The exact per-kind payload shape is owned by the brief compiler and result gate introduced in a later task, not by this schema.

created_at.description: When the envelope was appended to the mailbox.

previous_hash.description: The sha256 hex digest (scripts/kernel_specs.py's Envelope.hash()) of the canonical JSON of the envelope immediately before this one in its run's mailbox, chaining this entry to it so tampering with an earlier entry breaks this field's match. The first envelope in a run's mailbox uses scripts/kernel_specs.py's fixed GENESIS_HASH constant (64 hex zeros) instead of a real predecessor's hash. An envelope's own hash is always derived from its canonical JSON, never stored as a field on itself; only the *next* envelope's previous_hash pins it. This is set by scripts/adapter_port.py's AdapterPort._append, the single choke point every envelope passes through, so producers never compute it themselves.
